pairs: The burden of the desert of the sea.
Just as the whirlwinds approach from Africa,
A difficult vision has been announced to me:
he who is unbelieving, he acts unfaithfully,
and he who is a plunderer, he devastates.
I have caused all its mourning to cease.
Propterea repleti sunt lumbi mei dolore;
Because of this, my lower back has been filled with pain,
angustia possedit me sicut angustia parturientis;
and anguish has possessed me, like the anguish of a woman in labor.
I fell down when I heard it.
I was disturbed when I saw it.
Babylon dilecta mea posita est mihi in miraculum.
Babylon, my beloved, has become a wonder to me.

Contemplate, from a place of observation, those who eat and drink.
For the Lord has said this to me:
And let him announce whatever he will see.”
And he saw a chariot with two horsemen,
and a rider on a donkey,
and a rider on a camel.
et contemplatus est diligenter multo intuitu.
And he considered them diligently, with an intense gaze.
“I am on the watchtower of the Lord,
et super custodiam meam ego sum,
And I am at my station,
Ecce iste venit ascensor vir bigæ equitum;
Behold, a certain man approaches, a man riding on a two-horse chariot.”
et omnia sculptilia deorum ejus contrita sunt in terram.
And all its graven gods have been crushed into the earth!
O sons of my threshing floor!
What I have heard from the Lord of hosts,
cried out to me from Seir:
In the forest you shall sleep,
in the evening on the paths of Dedanim.
You who inhabit the land of the south:
upon meeting the thirsty, bring water;
For they are fleeing before the face of swords,
before the face of a sword hanging over them,
before the face of a bent bow,
before the face of a grievous battle.
Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus ad me:
For the Lord said this to me:
just like one year for a hired hand,
all the glory of Kedar will be taken away.
Et reliquiæ numeri sagittariorum fortium de filiis Cedar imminuentur;
And the remainder of the multitude of strong archers from the sons of Kedar will be few,
Dominus enim Deus Israël locutus est.
for the Lord, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
